collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Watching moss grow on a hut roof, a gardener wonders whether distant people might grow gardens on top of their houses.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching moss grow on a hut roof, (name1), a gardener, wonders whether distant people might grow gardens on top of their houses.

choices.label: Imagine Why They Would Need It.
Try Planting on a Hut Roof.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The gardener imagines rows of vegetables high above the ground and loves the idea.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder wonders whether the roof would hold the weight.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar suggests that crowded places might have no room for gardens on the ground.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A farmer says Isola has plenty of ground, and the roof is fine as it is.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A few herbs grow happily on a low roof.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The plants die in the hot sun, and the gardener decides some ideas stay far away.

text_only.reason: a death only talked about (or the word's everyday sense); nobody dies -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)
